<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Lockrot\Composer;

use Composer\Config;
use Composer\Downloader\TransportException;
use Composer\IO\IOInterface;
use Composer\Util\Http\Response;
use Composer\Util\HttpDownloader;
use Composer\Util\Loop;
use Composer\Util\RemoteFilesystem;
use Composer\Util\Url;
use Lockrot\Clock;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\CachingHttpClient;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpClientInterface;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpResult;
use Lockrot\Data\Repository\RepositoryUrl;
use Lockrot\Deadline;

/**
 * A HttpDownloader from Factory::createHttpDownloader() is sync-only, and add() throws a
 * LogicException until async is enabled. The constructor of Composer\Util\Loop enables it, and
 * Composer marks HttpDownloader::enableAsync() internal, so this class wraps the downloader in Loop.
 *
 * @internal
 */
final class ComposerHttpClient implements HttpClientInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10;
    /** Composer's own cap on the hops of one request. */
    private const MAX_REDIRECTS = 20;

    private HttpDownloader $downloader;
    private IOInterface $io;
    private Config $config;
    private Clock $clock;
    private Deadline $deadline;
    private bool $refusesRedirects;

    /**
     * @param IOInterface $io       the IO that the downloader was built with, see {@see withoutRedundantAuthorization()}
     * @param Config      $config   the Config that the downloader was built with: Composer resolves the origin of a request against its `gitlab-domains`
     * @param ?Deadline   $deadline install-time budget, where null or a never-expiring deadline keeps {@see DEFAULT_TIMEOUT}
     * @param ?bool       $refusesRedirects whether the downloader takes `prevent_url_access_callable`, null for whether curl runs it: RemoteFilesystem throws on the option
     */
    public function __construct(HttpDownloader $downloader, IOInterface $io, Config $config, Clock $clock, ?Deadline $deadline = null, ?bool $refusesRedirects = null)
    {
        $this->refusesRedirects = $refusesRedirects ?? HttpDownloader::isCurlEnabled();
        $this->downloader = (new Loop($downloader))->getHttpDownloader();
        $this->io = $io;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->clock = $clock;
        $this->deadline = $deadline ?? Deadline::never();
    }

    /**
     * The timeout of each request in the next fetchAll(): the default, or the time left of the
     * budget, at least one second. It is read at request time, because the repository-metadata pass
     * runs after construction, and with a frozen value the activity requests outlast the budget.
     */
    public function timeoutSeconds(): int
    {
        return self::timeoutFor($this->deadline);
    }

    public static function timeoutFor(Deadline $deadline): int
    {
        if ($deadline->isNever()) {
            return self::DEFAULT_TIMEOUT;
        }

        return max(1, (int) ceil($deadline->remainingSeconds()));
    }

    /**
     * $headers without lockrot's own credential headers (`Authorization`, `PRIVATE-TOKEN`) when
     * Composer's AuthHelper adds credentials of its own, because a request with two is refused and
     * GitHub answers 401 "Bad credentials". The origin and credential rules copy Composer's
     * AuthHelper, so the header that Composer adds is the one on the wire. The token that lockrot
     * resolved still lifts the repository-activity cap. See docs/internals.md#which-credentials.
     *
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function withoutRedundantAuthorization(IOInterface $io, Config $config, string $url, array $headers): array
    {
        if ($url === '') {
            return $headers;
        }
        $origin = Url::getOrigin($config, $url);
        if (!$io->hasAuthentication($origin)) {
            // The fallback of AuthHelper::findAuthOrigin(). getOrigin() folds `api.github.com` into
            // github.com, so it never arrives here, but it stays listed to match.
            if (!\in_array($origin, ['api.bitbucket.org', 'api.github.com'], true) || !$io->hasAuthentication((string) substr($origin, 4))) {
                return $headers;
            }
            $origin = (string) substr($origin, 4);
        }
        $auth = $io->getAuthentication($origin);
        // AuthHelper adds a github.com OAuth token to api.github.com requests only, so lockrot's
        // header stays on any other github.com URL.
        if ($origin === 'github.com' && $auth['password'] === 'x-oauth-basic' && preg_match('{^https?://api\.github\.com/}', $url) !== 1) {
            return $headers;
        }
        // AuthHelper adds no credential header for an SSL client certificate, or for custom headers
        // that carry none, so lockrot's header stays.
        if ($auth['username'] === 'client-certificate') {
            return $headers;
        }
        if ($auth['password'] === 'custom-headers') {
            $custom = json_decode((string) $auth['username'], true);
            if (!\is_array($custom) || !self::carriesCredentials($custom)) {
                return $headers;
            }
        }

        return self::withoutCredentials($headers);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private static function withoutCredentials(array $headers): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($headers, static fn (string $header): bool => !CachingHttpClient::isCredentialHeader($header)));
    }

    /** @param array<mixed> $headers */
    private static function carriesCredentials(array $headers): bool
    {
        foreach ($headers as $header) {
            if (\is_string($header) && CachingHttpClient::isCredentialHeader($header)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function fetchAll(array $urls, array $headers = []): array
    {
        /** @var array<string, HttpResult> $results */
        $results = [];
        /** @var array<string, string> $redirects url => the URL on another origin that a redirect named */
        $redirects = [];
        /** @var array<string, string> $stopped the URLs whose request, redirect hop or retry the install-time budget stopped */
        $stopped = [];
        // Composer's curl downloader asks this before each request, hop and retry starts.
        // Requests above its limit wait in a queue.
        $budgetEnded = function (string $url) use (&$stopped): bool {
            if (!$this->deadline->isPast()) {
                return false;
            }
            $stopped[$url] = $url;

            return true;
        };
        foreach (array_unique($urls) as $url) {
            // Without curl, add() blocks until the request ends, so each request starts inside the budget.
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $stopped[$url] = $url;

                continue;
            }
            $sent = self::withoutRedundantAuthorization($this->io, $this->config, $url, $headers);
            $options = self::options($this->timeoutSeconds(), $sent);
            if (!$this->refusesRedirects && self::carriesCredentials($sent)) {
                $this->fetchHolding($url, $options, $results, $redirects);
                continue;
            }
            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static function (string $target) use ($url, &$redirects, $budgetEnded): bool {
                    if ($budgetEnded($url)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    if ($target === '' || self::origin($target) === self::origin($url)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                    $redirects[$url] = $target;

                    return true;
                };
            }
            $this->add($url, $url, $options, $results);
        }
        $this->downloader->wait();
        // Composer replays the request's own headers to a redirect's target, so the request goes
        // again to that target without lockrot's credentials.
        foreach ($redirects as $url => $target) {
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $stopped[$url] = $url;

                continue;
            }
            // Composer's downloader throws a TypeError on a URL without a host, which would end the run,
            // and without curl it reads a file:// URL from the disk.
            if (!\in_array(strtolower((string) parse_url($target, \PHP_URL_SCHEME)), ['http', 'https'], true) || (string) parse_url($target, \PHP_URL_HOST) === '') {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'redirect to a URL that is not http or https with a host', $this->clock->now());

                continue;
            }
            $options = self::options($this->timeoutSeconds(), self::withoutCredentials($headers));
            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static fn (): bool => $budgetEnded($url);
            }
            $this->add($url, $target, $options, $results);
        }
        if ($redirects !== []) {
            $this->downloader->wait();
        }
        foreach ($stopped as $url) {
            $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());
        }
        foreach ($urls as $url) {
            if (!isset($results[$url])) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'no response', $this->clock->now());
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false, prevent_url_access_callable?: \Closure(string): bool} $options
     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                                                                        $results the answer for $url goes in here
     */
    private function add(string $url, string $target, array $options, array &$results): void
    {
        $this->downloader->add($target, $options)->then(
            function (Response $response) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = new HttpResult($url, $response->getStatusCode(), $response->getBody(), $this->clock->now(), null, array_values($response->getHeaders()));
            },
            function (\Throwable $e) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);
            }
        );
    }

    private function failed(string $url, \Throwable $e): HttpResult
    {
        $status = $e instanceof TransportException ? (int) ($e->getStatusCode() ?? 0) : 0;
        $headers = $e instanceof TransportException ? $e->getHeaders() ?? [] : [];

        return new HttpResult($url, $status, null, $this->clock->now(), RepositoryUrl::inText($e->getMessage()), array_values(array_filter($headers, 'is_string')));
    }

    /**
     * A request with lockrot's credentials where the downloader cannot stop a redirect: without
     * curl. RemoteFilesystem follows no hop past its `redirects` cap, so lockrot
     * follows a same-origin hop with the credentials. A target on another origin goes in $redirects
     * for a request without them.
     *
     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false} $options
     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                       $results
     * @param array<string, string>                                                           $redirects
     */
    private function fetchHolding(string $url, array $options, array &$results, array &$redirects): void
    {
        $filesystem = new RemoteFilesystem($this->io, $this->config, $this->downloader->getOptions(), (bool) $this->config->get('disable-tls'));
        $target = $url;
        for ($hop = 0; $hop <= self::MAX_REDIRECTS && $target !== ''; ++$hop) {
            // Each request blocks until it ends, so it takes only what the install-time budget has left.
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());

                return;
            }
            $options['http']['timeout'] = $this->timeoutSeconds();
            try {
                $body = $filesystem->getContents(Url::getOrigin($this->config, $target), $target, false, $options + ['redirects' => \PHP_INT_MAX]);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);

                return;
            }
            $headers = $filesystem->getLastHeaders();
            $status = (int) RemoteFilesystem::findStatusCode($headers);
            $location = $status >= 300 && $status < 400 ? Response::findHeaderValue($headers, 'location') : null;
            if ($location === null || $location === '') {
                $results[$url] = new HttpResult($url, $status, \is_string($body) ? $body : null, $this->clock->now(), null, $headers);

                return;
            }
            $next = self::resolve($target, $location);
            if (self::origin($next) !== self::origin($target)) {
                $redirects[$url] = $next;

            }
            $target = $next;
        }
        $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'too many redirects', $this->clock->now());
    }

    /** A `Location` against the URL that answered it, as Composer's CurlDownloader reads it. */
    private static function resolve(string $base, string $location): string
    {
        if (parse_url($location, \PHP_URL_SCHEME) !== null) {
            return $location;
        }
        $scheme = (string) parse_url($base, \PHP_URL_SCHEME);
        if (strpos($location, '//') === 0) {
            return $scheme.':'.$location;
        }
        if ($location[0] === '/') {
            return (string) preg_replace('{^([^:]+://[^/?#]+).*$}', '$1', $base).$location;
        }

        return (string) preg_replace('{^(.+/)[^/?]*(?:\?.*)?$}', '${1}', $base).$location;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false}
     */
    private static function options(int $timeout, array $headers): array
    {
        return ['http' => ['timeout' => $timeout, 'header' => $headers], 'retry-auth-failure' => false];
    }

    private static function origin(string $url): string
    {
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if (!\is_array($parts)) {
            return '';
        }

        return strtolower(($parts['scheme'] ?? '').'://'.($parts['host'] ?? '')).':'.(string) ($parts['port'] ?? '');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Lockrot\Solver;

use Composer\Package\AliasPackage;
use Composer\Package\BasePackage;
use Composer\Package\CompletePackage;
use Composer\Package\Version\StabilityFilter;
use Composer\Repository\ArrayRepository;
use Composer\Repository\ComposerRepository;
use Composer\Repository\ConfigurableRepositoryInterface;
use Composer\Repository\FilterRepository;
use Composer\Repository\PackageRepository;
use Composer\Repository\PathRepository;
use Composer\Repository\RepositoryInterface;
use Lockrot\Deadline;

/**
 * Loads a name's versions from the project's Composer, package and path repositories: the tagged stabilities first,
 * then `dev` for a name with no tagged release or one that the root admits at `dev`, as Composer's
 * repository loads a name's `~dev` file. Composer serves a file
 * that this process already fetched from its cache, so a name that the run read costs no request.
 * The first canonical repository that lists a name shadows the later ones. A repository with `only`,
 * `exclude` or `canonical` is asked as Composer asks it, through its FilterRepository. A vcs or
 * other repository is not loaded. It serves the names that the lock records from its URL. A name
 * that it serves before a canonical repository lists the name is {@see VersionSource::SHADOWED}
 * (docs/verdicts.md#the-move-check).
 *
 * @internal
 */
final class RepositoryVersions implements VersionSource
{
    private const STABLE = [
        'stable' => BasePackage::STABILITY_STABLE,
        'RC' => BasePackage::STABILITY_RC,
        'beta' => BasePackage::STABILITY_BETA,
        'alpha' => BasePackage::STABILITY_ALPHA,
    ];
    private const DEV = ['dev' => BasePackage::STABILITY_DEV];

    /** @var list<RepositoryInterface> in Composer's order */
    private array $repositories;
    private bool $otherRepositories;
    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $notFromComposerRepository;
    private bool $offline;
    private Deadline $deadline;
    /** @var array<string, list<BasePackage>> */
    private array $loaded = [];
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $failures = [];
    /** @var array<string, null> the names whose every version loaded: a failed request keeps them */
    private array $complete = [];
    /** @var array<key-of<BasePackage::STABILITIES>, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> */
    private array $acceptable;
    /** @var array<string, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> */
    private array $stabilityFlags;
    /** @var array<string, list<string>> */
    private array $served;

    /**
     * @param list<RepositoryInterface> $repositories              a Composer, package or path repository is asked, through the FilterRepository that wraps it
     * @param list<string>              $notFromComposerRepository the locked names that a path, VCS or package repository serves: the lock's version is their only version
     * @param string                    $minimumStability          the root's `minimum-stability`
     * @param array<string, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> $stabilityFlags the root's stability flags, by name
     * @param array<string, list<string>>             $served         by {@see urlKey()} of a repository URL, the names that the lock records from it
     */
    public function __construct(array $repositories, array $notFromComposerRepository, bool $offline, Deadline $deadline, string $minimumStability = 'stable', array $stabilityFlags = [], array $served = [])
    {
        $this->served = $served;
        $floor = BasePackage::$stabilities[$minimumStability] ?? BasePackage::STABILITY_STABLE;
        $this->acceptable = array_filter(BasePackage::$stabilities, static fn (int $value): bool => $value <= $floor);
        $this->stabilityFlags = $stabilityFlags;
        $this->repositories = $repositories;
        $this->otherRepositories = array_filter($repositories, static fn (RepositoryInterface $repository): bool => !self::isRead($repository)) !== [];
        $this->notFromComposerRepository = array_fill_keys($notFromComposerRepository, true);
        $this->offline = $offline;
        $this->deadline = $deadline;
    }

    public function versions(string $name): array
    {
        return $this->versionsOf([$name])[$name];
    }

    public function versionsOf(array $names): array
    {
        $missing = array_filter($names, fn (string $name): bool => !isset($this->loaded[$name]));
        if ($missing !== []) {
            $this->load($missing);
        }
        $versions = [];
        foreach ($names as $name) {
            $versions[$name] = $this->loaded[$name];
        }

        return $versions;
    }

    public function failure(string $name): ?string
    {
        return $this->failures[$name] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Asks each repository for the names together, so Composer sends the requests side by side.
     * One failed request fails them all: the names that it leaves are loaded one by one.
     *
     * @param array<string> $names
     */
    private function load(array $names): void
    {
        $pending = array_diff_key(array_fill_keys($names, null), $this->notFromComposerRepository);
        $this->loaded += array_fill_keys($names, []);

        try {
            $this->loadTogether($pending);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            // A transport failure or an answer that does not parse (Seld\JsonLint\ParsingException).
            // A name with versions still to load, such as an admitted name with its tags only, loads again alone.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Lockrot\Solver;

use Composer\Package\AliasPackage;
use Composer\Package\BasePackage;
use Composer\Package\CompletePackage;
use Composer\Package\Version\StabilityFilter;
use Composer\Repository\ArrayRepository;
use Composer\Repository\ComposerRepository;
use Composer\Repository\ConfigurableRepositoryInterface;
use Composer\Repository\FilterRepository;
use Composer\Repository\PackageRepository;
use Composer\Repository\PathRepository;
use Composer\Repository\RepositoryInterface;
use Lockrot\Deadline;

/**
 * Loads a name's versions from the project's Composer, package and path repositories: the tagged stabilities first,
 * then `dev` for a name with no tagged release or one that the root admits at `dev`, as Composer's
 * repository loads a name's `~dev` file. Composer serves a file
 * that this process already fetched from its cache, so a name that the run read costs no request.
 * The first canonical repository that lists a name shadows the later ones. A repository with `only`,
 * `exclude` or `canonical` is asked as Composer asks it, through its FilterRepository. A vcs or
 * other repository is not loaded. It serves the names that the lock records from its URL. A name
 * that it serves before a canonical repository lists the name is {@see VersionSource::SHADOWED}
 * (docs/verdicts.md#the-move-check).
 *
 * @internal
 */
final class RepositoryVersions implements VersionSource
{
    private const STABLE = [
        'stable' => BasePackage::STABILITY_STABLE,
        'RC' => BasePackage::STABILITY_RC,
        'beta' => BasePackage::STABILITY_BETA,
        'alpha' => BasePackage::STABILITY_ALPHA,
    ];
    private const DEV = ['dev' => BasePackage::STABILITY_DEV];

    /** @var list<RepositoryInterface> in Composer's order */
    private array $repositories;
    private bool $otherRepositories;
    /** @var array<string, true> */
    private array $notFromComposerRepository;
    private bool $offline;
    private Deadline $deadline;
    /** @var array<string, list<BasePackage>> */
    private array $loaded = [];
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $failures = [];
    /** @var array<string, null> the names whose every version loaded: a failed request keeps them */
    private array $complete = [];
    /** @var array<key-of<BasePackage::STABILITIES>, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> */
    private array $acceptable;
    /** @var array<string, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> */
    private array $stabilityFlags;
    /** @var array<string, list<string>> */
    private array $served;

    /**
     * @param list<RepositoryInterface> $repositories              a Composer, package or path repository is asked, through the FilterRepository that wraps it
     * @param list<string>              $notFromComposerRepository the locked names that a path, VCS or package repository serves: the lock's version is their only version
     * @param string                    $minimumStability          the root's `minimum-stability`
     * @param array<string, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> $stabilityFlags the root's stability flags, by name
     * @param array<string, list<string>>             $served         by {@see urlKey()} of a repository URL, the names that the lock records from it
     */
    public function __construct(array $repositories, array $notFromComposerRepository, bool $offline, Deadline $deadline, string $minimumStability = 'stable', array $stabilityFlags = [], array $served = [])
    {
        $this->served = $served;
        $floor = BasePackage::$stabilities[$minimumStability] ?? BasePackage::STABILITY_STABLE;
        $this->acceptable = array_filter(BasePackage::$stabilities, static fn (int $value): bool => $value <= $floor);
        $this->stabilityFlags = $stabilityFlags;
        $this->repositories = $repositories;
        $this->otherRepositories = array_filter($repositories, static fn (RepositoryInterface $repository): bool => !self::isRead($repository)) !== [];
        $this->notFromComposerRepository = array_fill_keys($notFromComposerRepository, true);
        $this->offline = $offline;
        $this->deadline = $deadline;
    }

    public function versions(string $name): array
    {
        return $this->versionsOf([$name])[$name];
    }

    public function versionsOf(array $names): array
    {
        $missing = array_filter($names, fn (string $name): bool => !isset($this->loaded[$name]));
        if ($missing !== []) {
            $this->load($missing);
        }
        $versions = [];
        foreach ($names as $name) {
            $versions[$name] = $this->loaded[$name];
        }

        return $versions;
    }

    public function failure(string $name): ?string
    {
        return $this->failures[$name] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Asks each repository for the names together, so Composer sends the requests side by side.
     * One failed request fails them all: the names that it leaves are loaded one by one.
     *
     * @param array<string> $names
     */
    private function load(array $names): void
    {
        $pending = array_diff_key(array_fill_keys($names, null), $this->notFromComposerRepository);
        $this->loaded += array_fill_keys($names, []);

        try {
            $this->loadTogether($pending);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            // A transport failure or an answer that does not parse (Seld\JsonLint\ParsingException).
            // A name with versions still to load, such as an admitted name with its tags only, loads again alone.
            foreach (array_keys($pending) as $name) {
                if (!\array_key_exists($name, $this->complete)) {
                    $this->loaded[$name] = $this->loadOne($name);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** @param array<string, null> $pending */
    private function loadTogether(array $pending): void
    {
        $hidden = [];
        foreach ($this->repositories as $repository) {
            if (!self::isRead($repository)) {
                $hidden += array_filter($pending, fn (string $name): bool => $this->canHide($repository, $name), \ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY);

                continue;
            }
            $tagged = [];
            $listed = [];
            $found = [];
            foreach ([self::STABLE, self::DEV] as $stabilities) {
                $asked = array_diff_key($pending, $listed) + $tagged;
                if ($asked !== [] && $this->deadline->isPast()) {
                    // A name that this repository's tags answered and that needs no dev versions is loaded.
                    $this->overBudget(array_diff_key($pending, array_diff_key($found, $asked)));
                    $this->failures += array_fill_keys(array_keys($hidden), self::SHADOWED);

                    return;
                }
                $result = self::ask($repository, $asked, $stabilities);
                $found += array_fill_keys($result['namesFound'], null);
                $answered = [];
                foreach ($result['packages'] as $package) {
                    if ($package instanceof BasePackage && \array_key_exists($package->getName(), $asked)) {
                        $answered[$package->getName()][] = $package;
                    }
                }
                foreach ($answered as $name => $packages) {
                    $this->loaded[$name] = self::withNewVersions($this->loaded[$name], $packages);
                }
                $listed = array_intersect_key($pending, $answered);
                if ($stabilities === self::DEV) {
                    foreach (array_keys($tagged) as $name) {
                        $this->failOfflineWithoutDevFile($name, $result, $repository);
                    }
                } else {
                    $tagged = array_filter($listed, fn (string $name): bool => $this->admitsDev($name), \ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY);
                }
            }
            // A repository that is not canonical lists a name without claiming it: the later ones add their versions.
            $this->complete += $found;
            $pending = array_diff_key($pending, $found);
        }
        $this->failUnlisted(array_keys(array_diff_key($pending, array_filter($this->loaded))));
        $this->failures += array_fill_keys(array_keys($hidden), self::SHADOWED);
    }

    /** @return list<BasePackage> */
    private function loadOne(string $name): array
    {
        $failed = false;
        $hidden = false;
        $loaded = [];
        foreach ($this->repositories as $repository) {
            if (!self::isRead($repository)) {
                $hidden = $hidden || $this->canHide($repository, $name);

                continue;
            }
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                return $this->overBudget([$name => null]);
            }
            $versions = [];
            try {
                $tags = $repository->loadPackages([$name => null], self::STABLE, []);
                $versions = self::named($tags, $name);
                $found = $tags['namesFound'];
                if ($versions === [] || $this->admitsDev($name)) {
                    if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                        return $this->overBudget([$name => null]);
                    }
                    $dev = $repository->loadPackages([$name => null], self::DEV, []);
                    if ($versions !== [] && $this->failOfflineWithoutDevFile($name, $dev, $repository)) {
                        return [];
                    }
                    $versions = array_merge($versions, self::named($dev, $name));
                    $found = array_merge($found, $dev['namesFound']);
                }
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                $failed = true;
                // A repository that lists the name answers for it: its tags without its dev versions are no answer.
                if ($versions !== []) {
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            }
            $loaded = self::withNewVersions($loaded, $versions);
            if (\in_array($name, $found, true)) {
                return $this->shadowedIf($hidden, $name, $loaded);
            }
        }
        if ($failed) {
            $this->failures[$name] = self::FAILED;

            return [];
        }
        if ($loaded === []) {
            $this->failUnlisted([$name]);
        }

        return $this->shadowedIf($hidden, $name, $loaded);
    }

    /**
     * Drops what the names loaded so far: a name without all its versions has no answer.
     *
     * @param array<string, null> $names
     *
     * @return list<BasePackage> none
     */
    private function overBudget(array $names): array
    {
        foreach (array_keys($names) as $name) {
            $this->loaded[$name] = [];
            $this->failures[$name] = self::BUDGET;
        }

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @param list<BasePackage> $loaded
     *
     * @return list<BasePackage>
     */
    private function shadowedIf(bool $hidden, string $name, array $loaded): array
    {
        if ($hidden) {
            $this->failures += [$name => self::SHADOWED];
        }

        return $loaded;
    }

    /**
     * Why lockrot has no versions of names that no Composer repository lists: offline, Composer's
     * cache can lack the answer. Online, a path, VCS or package repository of the project can serve them.
     *
     * @param list<string> $names
     */
    private function failUnlisted(array $names): void
    {
        if ($this->offline) {
            $this->failures += array_fill_keys($names, self::OFFLINE);
        } elseif ($this->otherRepositories) {
            $this->failures += array_fill_keys($names, self::UNREACHED);
        }
    }

    /**
     * $packages without the versions that $loaded holds: Composer prefers the earlier repository's
     * copy of a version that two repositories list.
     *
     * @param list<BasePackage> $loaded
     * @param array<BasePackage> $packages
     *
     * @return list<BasePackage>
     */
    private static function withNewVersions(array $loaded, array $packages): array
    {
        $known = array_flip(array_map(static fn (BasePackage $package): string => self::base($package)->getVersion(), $loaded));
        foreach ($packages as $package) {
            if (!isset($known[self::base($package)->getVersion()])) {
                $loaded[] = $package;
            }
        }

        return $loaded;
    }

    /**
     * The repository's answer for $names, with no request for none.
     *
     * @param array<string, null> $names
     * @param array<key-of<BasePackage::STABILITIES>, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> $stabilities
     *
     * @return array{namesFound: array<string>, packages: array<BasePackage>}
     */
    private static function ask(RepositoryInterface $repository, array $names, array $stabilities): array
    {
        return $names === [] ? ['namesFound' => [], 'packages' => []] : $repository->loadPackages($names, $stabilities, []);
    }

    /**
     * @param array{packages: array<BasePackage>} $result a repository's answer
     *
     * @return array<BasePackage>
     */
    private static function named(array $result, string $name): array
    {
        return array_filter($result['packages'], static fn (BasePackage $package): bool => $package->getName() === $name);
    }

    /**
     * Offline, Composer reads a `~dev` file that its cache lacks as a 404, and its answer leaves the
     * name out of `namesFound`. The tags alone are then no answer, so the name is OFFLINE
     * (docs/verdicts.md#the-move-check). A repository that is not canonical leaves every name out,
     * so the repository that it wraps answers.
     *
     * @param array{namesFound: array<string>} $result the dev answer of the repository that lists the name's tags
     */
    private function failOfflineWithoutDevFile(string $name, array $result, RepositoryInterface $repository): bool
    {
        if (!$this->offline || \in_array($name, $result['namesFound'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($repository instanceof FilterRepository && \in_array($name, $repository->getRepository()->loadPackages([$name => null], self::DEV, [])['namesFound'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->failures[$name] = self::OFFLINE;
        $this->loaded[$name] = [];

        return true;
    }

    /** Whether the source asks $repository: a Composer, package or path repository, also through its FilterRepository. */
    private static function isRead(RepositoryInterface $repository): bool
    {
        $inner = $repository instanceof FilterRepository ? $repository->getRepository() : $repository;

        return $inner instanceof ComposerRepository || $inner instanceof PackageRepository || $inner instanceof PathRepository;
    }

    /** A repository URL as the lock and the config compare: no case, no trailing slash, no trailing `.git`. */
    public static function urlKey(string $url): string
    {
        $key = rtrim(strtolower($url), '/');
        if (substr($key, -4) === '.git') {
            $key = substr_replace($key, '', -4);
        }

        return rtrim($key, '/');
    }

    /**
     * Whether a repository that the source does not load serves $name and hides it: the lock
     * records $name from its URL, the repository is canonical, and its `only` or `exclude` admits
     * the name. A copy that holds only $name answers with those options, because asking the
     * repository itself loads it.
     */
    private function canHide(RepositoryInterface $repository, string $name): bool
    {
        $inner = $repository instanceof FilterRepository ? $repository->getRepository() : $repository;
        $config = $inner instanceof ConfigurableRepositoryInterface ? $inner->getRepoConfig() : [];
        $url = $config['url'] ?? null;
        if (!\is_string($url) || !\in_array($name, $this->served[self::urlKey($url)] ?? [], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $options = [];
        foreach (['only', 'exclude'] as $key) {
            if (isset($config[$key]) && \is_array($config[$key])) {
                $options[$key] = array_values(array_filter($config[$key], 'is_string'));
            }
        }
        if (\is_bool($config['canonical'] ?? null)) {
            $options['canonical'] = $config['canonical'];
        }
        $probe = new FilterRepository(new ArrayRepository([new CompletePackage($name, '1.0.0.0', '1.0.0')]), $options);

        return $probe->loadPackages([$name => null], self::STABLE, [])['namesFound'] !== [];
    }

    private static function base(BasePackage $package): BasePackage
    {
        return $package instanceof AliasPackage ? $package->getAliasOf() : $package;
    }

    private function admitsDev(string $name): bool
    {
        return StabilityFilter::isPackageAcceptable($this->acceptable, $this->stabilityFlags, [$name], 'dev');
    }
}

use Composer\Util\HttpDownloader;
use Composer\Util\Loop;
use Composer\Util\RemoteFilesystem;

use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpResult;

    private IOInterface $io;

    private Deadline $deadline;

    {

        $this->downloader = (new Loop($downloader))->getHttpDownloader();
        $this->io = $io;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->clock = $clock;
        $this->deadline = $deadline ?? Deadline::never();
    }

    /**
     * The timeout of each request in the next fetchAll(): the default, or the time left of the
     * budget, at least one second. It is read at request time, because the repository-metadata pass
     * runs after construction, and with a frozen value the activity requests outlast the budget.
     */

    }

    public static function timeoutFor(Deadline $deadline): int

        }

     * Composer's AuthHelper adds credentials of its own, because a request with two is refused and
     * GitHub answers 401 "Bad credentials". The origin and credential rules copy Composer's
     * AuthHelper, so the header that Composer adds is the one on the wire. The token that lockrot
     * resolved still lifts the repository-activity cap. See docs/internals.md#which-credentials.
     *
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function withoutRedundantAuthorization(IOInterface $io, Config $config, string $url, array $headers): array
    {

            return $headers;
        }
        $origin = Url::getOrigin($config, $url);
        if (!$io->hasAuthentication($origin)) {
            // The fallback of AuthHelper::findAuthOrigin(). getOrigin() folds `api.github.com` into
            // github.com, so it never arrives here, but it stays listed to match.
            if (!\in_array($origin, ['api.bitbucket.org', 'api.github.com'], true) || !$io->hasAuthentication((string) substr($origin, 4))) {

        $auth = $io->getAuthentication($origin);

        // header stays on any other github.com URL.

        // that carry none, so lockrot's header stays.

            $custom = json_decode((string) $auth['username'], true);

                        return true;
                    }
                    if ($target === '' || self::origin($target) === self::origin($url)) {
                        return false;
                    }

                };

        }

        // again to that target without lockrot's credentials.

                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static fn (): bool => $budgetEnded($url);
            }
            $this->add($url, $target, $options, $results);
        }

            $this->downloader->wait();
        }

            $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());
        }

            if (!isset($results[$url])) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'no response', $this->clock->now());
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false, prevent_url_access_callable?: \Closure(string): bool} $options

     */
    private function add(string $url, string $target, array $options, array &$results): void

            function (Response $response) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = new HttpResult($url, $response->getStatusCode(), $response->getBody(), $this->clock->now(), null, array_values($response->getHeaders()));
            },
            function (\Throwable $e) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);
            }
        );
    }

    private function failed(string $url, \Throwable $e): HttpResult
    {
        $status = $e instanceof TransportException ? (int) ($e->getStatusCode() ?? 0) : 0;
        $headers = $e instanceof TransportException ? $e->getHeaders() ?? [] : [];

        return new HttpResult($url, $status, null, $this->clock->now(), RepositoryUrl::inText($e->getMessage()), array_values(array_filter($headers, 'is_string')));
    }

    /**
     * A request with lockrot's credentials where the downloader cannot stop a redirect: without
     * curl. RemoteFilesystem follows no hop past its `redirects` cap, so lockrot
     * follows a same-origin hop with the credentials. A target on another origin goes in $redirects
     * for a request without them.
     *
     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false} $options
     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                       $results
     * @param array<string, string>                                                           $redirects
     */
    private function fetchHolding(string $url, array $options, array &$results, array &$redirects): void
    {
        $filesystem = new RemoteFilesystem($this->io, $this->config, $this->downloader->getOptions(), (bool) $this->config->get('disable-tls'));
        $target = $url;
        for ($hop = 0; $hop <= self::MAX_REDIRECTS && $target !== ''; ++$hop) {
            // Each request blocks until it ends, so it takes only what the install-time budget has left.
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());

                return;
            }
            $options['http']['timeout'] = $this->timeoutSeconds();
            try {
                $body = $filesystem->getContents(Url::getOrigin($this->config, $target), $target, false, $options + ['redirects' => \PHP_INT_MAX]);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);

                return;
            }
            $headers = $filesystem->getLastHeaders();
            $status = (int) RemoteFilesystem::findStatusCode($headers);
            $location = $status >= 300 && $status < 400 ? Response::findHeaderValue($headers, 'location') : null;
            if ($location === null || $location === '') {
                $results[$url] = new HttpResult($url, $status, \is_string($body) ? $body : null, $this->clock->now(), null, $headers);

                return;
            }
            $next = self::resolve($target, $location);
            if (self::origin($next) !== self::origin($target)) {
                $redirects[$url] = $next;

                return;
            }
            $target = $next;
        }
        $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'too many redirects', $this->clock->now());
    }

    /** A `Location` against the URL that answered it, as Composer's CurlDownloader reads it. */
    private static function resolve(string $base, string $location): string
    {
        if (parse_url($location, \PHP_URL_SCHEME) !== null) {
            return $location;
        }
        $scheme = (string) parse_url($base, \PHP_URL_SCHEME);
        if (strpos($location, '//') === 0) {
            return $scheme.':'.$location;
        }
        if ($location[0] === '/') {
            return (string) preg_replace('{^([^:]+://[^/?#]+).*$}', '$1', $base).$location;
        }

        return (string) preg_replace('{^(.+/)[^/?]*(?:\?.*)?$}', '${1}', $base).$location;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false}
     */
    private static function options(int $timeout, array $headers): array
    {
        return ['http' => ['timeout' => $timeout, 'header' => $headers], 'retry-auth-failure' => false];
    }

    private static function origin(string $url): string
    {
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if (!\is_array($parts)) {
            return '';
        }

        return strtolower(($parts['scheme'] ?? '').'://'.($parts['host'] ?? '')).':'.(string) ($parts['port'] ?? '');
    }
}

namespace Lockrot\Composer;

use Composer\Config;
use Composer\Downloader\TransportException;

use Composer\Util\Loop;
use Composer\Util\RemoteFilesystem;

     * runs after construction, and with a frozen value the activity requests outlast the budget.

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Lockrot\Composer;

use Composer\Config;
use Composer\Downloader\TransportException;
use Composer\IO\IOInterface;
use Composer\Util\Http\Response;
use Composer\Util\HttpDownloader;
use Composer\Util\Loop;
use Composer\Util\RemoteFilesystem;
use Composer\Util\Url;
use Lockrot\Clock;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\CachingHttpClient;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpClientInterface;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpResult;
use Lockrot\Data\Repository\RepositoryUrl;
use Lockrot\Deadline;

/**
 * A HttpDownloader from Factory::createHttpDownloader() is sync-only, and add() throws a
 * LogicException until async is enabled. The constructor of Composer\Util\Loop enables it, and
 * Composer marks HttpDownloader::enableAsync() internal, so this class wraps the downloader in Loop.
 *
 * @internal
 */
final class ComposerHttpClient implements HttpClientInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10;
    /** Composer's own cap on the hops of one request. */
    private const MAX_REDIRECTS = 20;

    private HttpDownloader $downloader;
    private IOInterface $io;
    private Config $config;
    private Clock $clock;
    private Deadline $deadline;
    private bool $refusesRedirects;

    /**
     * @param IOInterface $io       the IO that the downloader was built with, see {@see withoutRedundantAuthorization()}
     * @param Config      $config   the Config that the downloader was built with: Composer resolves the origin of a request against its `gitlab-domains`
     * @param ?Deadline   $deadline install-time budget, where null or a never-expiring deadline keeps {@see DEFAULT_TIMEOUT}
     * @param ?bool       $refusesRedirects whether the downloader takes `prevent_url_access_callable`, null for whether curl runs it: RemoteFilesystem throws on the option
     */
    public function __construct(HttpDownloader $downloader, IOInterface $io, Config $config, Clock $clock, ?Deadline $deadline = null, ?bool $refusesRedirects = null)
    {
        $this->refusesRedirects = $refusesRedirects ?? HttpDownloader::isCurlEnabled();
        $this->downloader = (new Loop($downloader))->getHttpDownloader();
        $this->io = $io;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->clock = $clock;
        $this->deadline = $deadline ?? Deadline::never();
    }

    /**
     * The timeout of each request in the next fetchAll(): the default, or the time left of the
     * budget, at least one second. It is read at request time, because the repository-metadata pass
     * runs after construction, and with a frozen value the activity requests outlast the budget.
     */
    public function timeoutSeconds(): int
    {
        return self::timeoutFor($this->deadline);
    }

    public static function timeoutFor(Deadline $deadline): int
    {
        if ($deadline->isNever()) {
            return self::DEFAULT_TIMEOUT;
        }

        return max(1, (int) ceil($deadline->remainingSeconds()));
    }

    /**
     * $headers without lockrot's own credential headers (`Authorization`, `PRIVATE-TOKEN`) when
     * Composer's AuthHelper adds credentials of its own, because a request with two is refused and
     * GitHub answers 401 "Bad credentials". The origin and credential rules copy Composer's
     * AuthHelper, so the header that Composer adds is the one on the wire. The token that lockrot
     * resolved still lifts the repository-activity cap. See docs/internals.md#which-credentials.
     *
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function withoutRedundantAuthorization(IOInterface $io, Config $config, string $url, array $headers): array
    {
        if ($url === '') {
            return $headers;
        }
        $origin = Url::getOrigin($config, $url);
        if (!$io->hasAuthentication($origin)) {
            // The fallback of AuthHelper::findAuthOrigin(). getOrigin() folds `api.github.com` into
            // github.com, so it never arrives here, but it stays listed to match.
            if (!\in_array($origin, ['api.bitbucket.org', 'api.github.com'], true) || !$io->hasAuthentication((string) substr($origin, 4))) {
                return $headers;
            }
            $origin = (string) substr($origin, 4);
        }
        $auth = $io->getAuthentication($origin);
        // AuthHelper adds a github.com OAuth token to api.github.com requests only, so lockrot's
        // header stays on any other github.com URL.
        if ($origin === 'github.com' && $auth['password'] === 'x-oauth-basic' && preg_match('{^https?://api\.github\.com/}', $url) !== 1) {
            return $headers;
        }
        // AuthHelper adds no credential header for an SSL client certificate, or for custom headers
        // that carry none, so lockrot's header stays.
        if ($auth['username'] === 'client-certificate') {
            return $headers;
        }
        if ($auth['password'] === 'custom-headers') {
            $custom = json_decode((string) $auth['username'], true);
            if (!\is_array($custom) || !self::carriesCredentials($custom)) {
                return $headers;
            }
        }

        return self::withoutCredentials($headers);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private static function withoutCredentials(array $headers): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($headers, static fn (string $header): bool => !CachingHttpClient::isCredentialHeader($header)));
    }

    /** @param array<mixed> $headers */
    private static function carriesCredentials(array $headers): bool
    {
        foreach ($headers as $header) {
            if (\is_string($header) && CachingHttpClient::isCredentialHeader($header)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public function fetchAll(array $urls, array $headers = []): array
    {
        /** @var array<string, HttpResult> $results */
        $results = [];
        /** @var array<string, string> $redirects url => the URL on another origin that a redirect named */
        $redirects = [];
        /** @var array<string, string> $stopped the URLs whose request, redirect hop or retry the install-time budget stopped */
        $stopped = [];
        // Composer's curl downloader asks this before each request, hop and retry starts.
        // Requests above its limit wait in a queue.
        $budgetEnded = function (string $url) use (&$stopped): bool {
            if (!$this->deadline->isPast()) {
                return false;
            }
            $stopped[$url] = $url;

            return true;
        };
        foreach (array_unique($urls) as $url) {
            // Without curl, add() blocks until the request ends, so each request starts inside the budget.
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $stopped[$url] = $url;

                continue;
            }
            $sent = self::withoutRedundantAuthorization($this->io, $this->config, $url, $headers);
            $options = self::options($this->timeoutSeconds(), $sent);
            if (!$this->refusesRedirects && self::carriesCredentials($sent)) {
                $this->fetchHolding($url, $options, $results, $redirects);
                continue;
            }
            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static function (string $target) use ($url, &$redirects, $budgetEnded): bool {
                    if ($budgetEnded($url)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    if ($target === '' || self::origin($target) === self::origin($url)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                    $redirects[$url] = $target;

                    return true;
                };
            }
            $this->add($url, $url, $options, $results);
        }
        $this->downloader->wait();
        // Composer replays the request's own headers to a redirect's target, so the request goes
        // again to that target without lockrot's credentials.
        foreach ($redirects as $url => $target) {
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $stopped[$url] = $url;

                continue;
            }
            // Composer's downloader throws a TypeError on a URL without a host, which would end the run,
            // and without curl it reads a file:// URL from the disk.
            if (!\in_array(strtolower((string) parse_url($target, \PHP_URL_SCHEME)), ['http', 'https'], true) || (string) parse_url($target, \PHP_URL_HOST) === '') {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'redirect to a URL that is not http or https with a host', $this->clock->now());

                continue;
            }
            $options = self::options($this->timeoutSeconds(), self::withoutCredentials($headers));
            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static fn (): bool => $budgetEnded($url);
            }
            $this->add($url, $target, $options, $results);
        }
        if ($redirects !== []) {
            $this->downloader->wait();
        }
        foreach ($stopped as $url) {
            $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());
        }
        foreach ($urls as $url) {
            if (!isset($results[$url])) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'no response', $this->clock->now());
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false, prevent_url_access_callable?: \Closure(string): bool} $options
     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                                                                        $results the answer for $url goes in here
     */
    private function add(string $url, string $target, array $options, array &$results): void
    {
        $this->downloader->add($target, $options)->then(
            function (Response $response) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = new HttpResult($url, $response->getStatusCode(), $response->getBody(), $this->clock->now(), null, array_values($response->getHeaders()));
            },
            function (\Throwable $e) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);
            }
        );
    }

    private function failed(string $url, \Throwable $e): HttpResult
    {
        $status = $e instanceof TransportException ? (int) ($e->getStatusCode() ?? 0) : 0;
        $headers = $e instanceof TransportException ? $e->getHeaders() ?? [] : [];

        return new HttpResult($url, $status, null, $this->clock->now(), RepositoryUrl::inText($e->getMessage()), array_values(array_filter($headers, 'is_string')));
    }

    /**
     * A request with lockrot's credentials where the downloader cannot stop a redirect: without
     * curl. RemoteFilesystem follows no hop past its `redirects` cap, so lockrot
     * follows a same-origin hop with the credentials. A target on another origin goes in $redirects
     * for a request without them.
     *
     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false} $options
     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                       $results
     * @param array<string, string>                                                           $redirects
     */
    private function fetchHolding(string $url, array $options, array &$results, array &$redirects): void
    {
        $filesystem = new RemoteFilesystem($this->io, $this->config, $this->downloader->getOptions(), (bool) $this->config->get('disable-tls'));
        $target = $url;
        for ($hop = 0; $hop <= self::MAX_REDIRECTS && $target !== ''; ++$hop) {
            // Each request blocks until it ends, so it takes only what the install-time budget has left.
            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());

                return;
            }
            $options['http']['timeout'] = $this->timeoutSeconds();
            try {
                $body = $filesystem->getContents(Url::getOrigin($this->config, $target), $target, false, $options + ['redirects' => \PHP_INT_MAX]);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);

                return;
            }
            $headers = $filesystem->getLastHeaders();
            $status = (int) RemoteFilesystem::findStatusCode($headers);
            $location = $status >= 300 && $status < 400 ? Response::findHeaderValue($headers, 'location') : null;
            if ($location === null || $location === '') {
                $results[$url] = new HttpResult($url, $status, \is_string($body) ? $body : null, $this->clock->now(), null, $headers);

                return;
            }
            $next = self::resolve($target, $location);
            if (self::origin($next) !== self::origin($target)) {
                $redirects[$url] = $next;

            }

        }
        $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'too many redirects', $this->clock->now());
    }

    /** A `Location` against the URL that answered it, as Composer's CurlDownloader reads it. */

    {
        if (parse_url($location, \PHP_URL_SCHEME) !== null) {
            return $location;
        }
        $scheme = (string) parse_url($base, \PHP_URL_SCHEME);
        if (strpos($location, '//') === 0) {
            return $scheme.':'.$location;
        }
        if ($location[0] === '/') {
            return (string) preg_replace('{^([^:]+://[^/?#]+).*$}', '$1', $base).$location;
        }

        return (string) preg_replace('{^(.+/)[^/?]*(?:\?.*)?$}', '${1}', $base).$location;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false}
     */
    private static function options(int $timeout, array $headers): array
    {
        return ['http' => ['timeout' => $timeout, 'header' => $headers], 'retry-auth-failure' => false];
    }

    private static function origin(string $url): string
    {
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if (!\is_array($parts)) {
            return '';
        }

        return strtolower(($parts['scheme'] ?? '').'://'.($parts['host'] ?? '')).':'.(string) ($parts['port'] ?? '');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Lockrot\Composer;

use Composer\Config;
use Composer\Downloader\TransportException;
use Composer\IO\IOInterface;
use Composer\Util\Http\Response;
use Composer\Util\HttpDownloader;
use Composer\Util\Loop;
use Composer\Util\RemoteFilesystem;
use Composer\Util\Url;
use Lockrot\Clock;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\CachingHttpClient;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpClientInterface;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpResult;
use Lockrot\Data\Repository\RepositoryUrl;
use Lockrot\Deadline;

/**
 * A HttpDownloader from Factory::createHttpDownloader() is sync-only, and add() throws a
 * LogicException until async is enabled. The constructor of Composer\Util\Loop enables it, and
 * Composer marks HttpDownloader::enableAsync() internal, so this class wraps the downloader in Loop.
 *
 * @internal

final class ComposerHttpClient implements HttpClientInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10;
    /** Composer's own cap on the hops of one request. */
    private const MAX_REDIRECTS = 20;

    private HttpDownloader $downloader;
    private IOInterface $io;
    private Config $config;
    private Clock $clock;
    private Deadline $deadline;
    private bool $refusesRedirects;

    /**
     * @param IOInterface $io       the IO that the downloader was built with, see {@see withoutRedundantAuthorization()}
     * @param Config      $config   the Config that the downloader was built with: Composer resolves the origin of a request against its `gitlab-domains`
     * @param ?Deadline   $deadline install-time budget, where null or a never-expiring deadline keeps {@see DEFAULT_TIMEOUT}
     * @param ?bool       $refusesRedirects whether the downloader takes `prevent_url_access_callable`, null for whether curl runs it: RemoteFilesystem throws on the option
     */
    public function __construct(HttpDownloader $downloader, IOInterface $io, Config $config, Clock $clock, ?Deadline $deadline = null, ?bool $refusesRedirects = null)
    {
        $this->refusesRedirects = $refusesRedirects ?? HttpDownloader::isCurlEnabled();
        $this->downloader = (new Loop($downloader))->getHttpDownloader();
        $this->io = $io;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->clock = $clock;
        $this->deadline = $deadline ?? Deadline::never();
    }

    /**
     * The timeout of each request in the next fetchAll(): the default, or the time left of the
     * budget, at least one second. It is read at request time, because the repository-metadata pass
     * runs after construction, and with a frozen value the activity requests outlast the budget.
     */
    public function timeoutSeconds(): int
    {
        return self::timeoutFor($this->deadline);
    }

    public static function timeoutFor(Deadline $deadline): int
    {
        if ($deadline->isNever()) {
            return self::DEFAULT_TIMEOUT;
        }

        return max(1, (int) ceil($deadline->remainingSeconds()));
    }

     * Composer's AuthHelper adds credentials of its own, because a request with two is refused and
     * GitHub answers 401 "Bad credentials". The origin and credential rules copy Composer's
     * AuthHelper, so the header that Composer adds is the one on the wire. The token that lockrot
     * resolved still lifts the repository-activity cap. See docs/internals.md#which-credentials.
     *
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */

            return $headers;

            // github.com, so it never arrives here, but it stays listed to match.
            if (!\in_array($origin, ['api.bitbucket.org', 'api.github.com'], true) || !$io->hasAuthentication((string) substr($origin, 4))) {

        $auth = $io->getAuthentication($origin);

        // header stays on any other github.com URL.
        if ($origin === 'github.com' && $auth['password'] === 'x-oauth-basic' && preg_match('{^https?://api\.github\.com/}', $url) !== 1) {

            if (\is_string($header) && CachingHttpClient::isCredentialHeader($header)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

        // Requests above its limit wait in a queue.
        $budgetEnded = function (string $url) use (&$stopped): bool {

            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {

                continue;
            }
            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static function (string $target) use ($url, &$redirects, $budgetEnded): bool {
                    if ($budgetEnded($url)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    if ($target === '' || self::origin($target) === self::origin($url)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                    $redirects[$url] = $target;

                    return true;
                };

        // again to that target without lockrot's credentials.
        foreach ($redirects as $url => $target) {

            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static fn (): bool => $budgetEnded($url);
            }
            $this->add($url, $target, $options, $results);
        }
        if ($redirects !== []) {
            $this->downloader->wait();
        }
        foreach ($stopped as $url) {
            $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());
        }
        foreach ($urls as $url) {
            if (!isset($results[$url])) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'no response', $this->clock->now());
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

    private function add(string $url, string $target, array $options, array &$results): void

            function (Response $response) use ($url, &$results): void {

            },
            function (\Throwable $e) use ($url, &$results): void {
                $results[$url] = $this->failed($url, $e);
            }
        );
    }

    private function failed(string $url, \Throwable $e): HttpResult
    {

        $headers = $e instanceof TransportException ? $e->getHeaders() ?? [] : [];

     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                       $results
     * @param array<string, string>                                                           $redirects

            }
            $target = $next;
        }

        }

        }

        return (string) preg_replace('{^(.+/)[^/?]*(?:\?.*)?$}', '${1}', $base).$location;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false}
     */
    private static function options(int $timeout, array $headers): array
    {

    }

    private static function origin(string $url): string
    {
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if (!\is_array($parts)) {
            return '';
        }

        return strtolower(($parts['scheme'] ?? '').'://'.($parts['host'] ?? '')).':'.(string) ($parts['port'] ?? '');
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Lockrot\Composer;

use Composer\Config;
use Composer\Downloader\TransportException;
use Composer\IO\IOInterface;
use Composer\Util\Http\Response;
use Composer\Util\HttpDownloader;
use Composer\Util\Loop;
use Composer\Util\RemoteFilesystem;
use Composer\Util\Url;
use Lockrot\Clock;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\CachingHttpClient;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpClientInterface;
use Lockrot\Data\Http\HttpResult;
use Lockrot\Data\Repository\RepositoryUrl;
use Lockrot\Deadline;

 * LogicException until async is enabled. The constructor of Composer\Util\Loop enables it, and
 * Composer marks HttpDownloader::enableAsync() internal, so this class wraps the downloader in Loop.
 *
 * @internal
 */
final class ComposerHttpClient implements HttpClientInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10;
    /** Composer's own cap on the hops of one request. */
    private const MAX_REDIRECTS = 20;

    private HttpDownloader $downloader;
    private IOInterface $io;
    private Config $config;
    private Clock $clock;
    private Deadline $deadline;
    private bool $refusesRedirects;

    /**
     * @param IOInterface $io       the IO that the downloader was built with, see {@see withoutRedundantAuthorization()}
     * @param Config      $config   the Config that the downloader was built with: Composer resolves the origin of a request against its `gitlab-domains`
     * @param ?Deadline   $deadline install-time budget, where null or a never-expiring deadline keeps {@see DEFAULT_TIMEOUT}
     * @param ?bool       $refusesRedirects whether the downloader takes `prevent_url_access_callable`, null for whether curl runs it: RemoteFilesystem throws on the option
     */
    public function __construct(HttpDownloader $downloader, IOInterface $io, Config $config, Clock $clock, ?Deadline $deadline = null, ?bool $refusesRedirects = null)
    {
        $this->refusesRedirects = $refusesRedirects ?? HttpDownloader::isCurlEnabled();
        $this->downloader = (new Loop($downloader))->getHttpDownloader();
        $this->io = $io;
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->clock = $clock;
        $this->deadline = $deadline ?? Deadline::never();
    }

    /**
     * The timeout of each request in the next fetchAll(): the default, or the time left of the
     * budget, at least one second. It is read at request time, because the repository-metadata pass
     * runs after construction, and with a frozen value the activity requests outlast the budget.
     */
    public function timeoutSeconds(): int
    {
        return self::timeoutFor($this->deadline);
    }

    public static function timeoutFor(Deadline $deadline): int
    {
        if ($deadline->isNever()) {
            return self::DEFAULT_TIMEOUT;
        }

        return max(1, (int) ceil($deadline->remainingSeconds()));
    }

     * Composer's AuthHelper adds credentials of its own, because a request with two is refused and
     * GitHub answers 401 "Bad credentials". The origin and credential rules copy Composer's
     * AuthHelper, so the header that Composer adds is the one on the wire. The token that lockrot
     * resolved still lifts the repository-activity cap. See docs/internals.md#which-credentials.
     *
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */

    {

            return $headers;

            // github.com, so it never arrives here, but it stays listed to match.
            if (!\in_array($origin, ['api.bitbucket.org', 'api.github.com'], true) || !$io->hasAuthentication((string) substr($origin, 4))) {

        // header stays on any other github.com URL.
        if ($origin === 'github.com' && $auth['password'] === 'x-oauth-basic' && preg_match('{^https?://api\.github\.com/}', $url) !== 1) {

        // that carry none, so lockrot's header stays.

            }
        }

        return false;
    }

        $redirects = [];

        // Requests above its limit wait in a queue.
        $budgetEnded = function (string $url) use (&$stopped): bool {

            if ($this->deadline->isPast()) {

            }
            if ($this->refusesRedirects) {
                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static function (string $target) use ($url, &$redirects, $budgetEnded): bool {
                    if ($budgetEnded($url)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    if ($target === '' || self::origin($target) === self::origin($url)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                    $redirects[$url] = $target;

                    return true;
                };

        // again to that target without lockrot's credentials.
        foreach ($redirects as $url => $target) {

                $options['prevent_url_access_callable'] = static fn (): bool => $budgetEnded($url);
            }
            $this->add($url, $target, $options, $results);
        }

            $this->downloader->wait();
        }

            $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'install-time budget spent', $this->clock->now());
        }
        foreach ($urls as $url) {
            if (!isset($results[$url])) {
                $results[$url] = HttpResult::failure($url, 'no response', $this->clock->now());
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

     * @param array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false, prevent_url_access_callable?: \Closure(string): bool} $options

    {

        $headers = $e instanceof TransportException ? $e->getHeaders() ?? [] : [];

     * curl. RemoteFilesystem follows no hop past its `redirects` cap, so lockrot
     * follows a same-origin hop with the credentials. A target on another origin goes in $redirects

     * @param array<string, HttpResult>                                                       $results

            }

        }

    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $headers
     *
     * @return array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false}

    private static function options(int $timeout, array $headers): array

    }

    {
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if (!\is_array($parts)) {
            return '';
        }

        return strtolower(($parts['scheme'] ?? '').'://'.($parts['host'] ?? '')).':'.(string) ($parts['port'] ?? '');
    }

     * @return array{http: array{timeout: int, header: list<string>}, retry-auth-failure: false}

    {

    }

use Composer\Repository\PackageRepository;

                continue;

     *

        }

    }

     */

     * @param array<key-of<BasePackage::STABILITIES>, BasePackage::STABILITY_*> $stabilities
     *

    }

    /**
     * @param array{packages: array<BasePackage>} $result a repository's answer
     *
     * @return array<BasePackage>
     */
    private static function named(array $result, string $name): array
    {
        return array_filter($result['packages'], static fn (BasePackage $package): bool => $package->getName() === $name);
    }

     * Offline, Composer reads a `~dev` file that its cache lacks as a 404, and its answer leaves the
     * name out of `namesFound`. The tags alone are then no answer, so the name is OFFLINE
     * (docs/verdicts.md#the-move-check). A repository that is not canonical leaves every name out,
     * so the repository that it wraps answers.
     *
     * @param array{namesFound: array<string>} $result the dev answer of the repository that lists the name's tags
     */
    private function failOfflineWithoutDevFile(string $name, array $result, RepositoryInterface $repository): bool
    {
        if (!$this->offline || \in_array($name, $result['namesFound'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($repository instanceof FilterRepository && \in_array($name, $repository->getRepository()->loadPackages([$name => null], self::DEV, [])['namesFound'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->failures[$name] = self::OFFLINE;
        $this->loaded[$name] = [];

        return true;
    }

    /** Whether the source asks $repository: a Composer, package or path repository, also through its FilterRepository. */
    private static function isRead(RepositoryInterface $repository): bool
    {
        $inner = $repository instanceof FilterRepository ? $repository->getRepository() : $repository;

        return $inner instanceof ComposerRepository || $inner instanceof PackageRepository || $inner instanceof PathRepository;
    }

    /** A repository URL as the lock and the config compare: no case, no trailing slash, no trailing `.git`. */
    public static function urlKey(string $url): string
    {
        $key = rtrim(strtolower($url), '/');
        if (substr($key, -4) === '.git') {
            $key = substr_replace($key, '', -4);
        }

        return rtrim($key, '/');
    }

    /**
     * Whether a repository that the source does not load serves $name and hides it: the lock
     * records $name from its URL, the repository is canonical, and its `only` or `exclude` admits
     * the name. A copy that holds only $name answers with those options, because asking the
     * repository itself loads it.
     */
    private function canHide(RepositoryInterface $repository, string $name): bool
    {
        $inner = $repository instanceof FilterRepository ? $repository->getRepository() : $repository;
        $config = $inner instanceof ConfigurableRepositoryInterface ? $inner->getRepoConfig() : [];
        $url = $config['url'] ?? null;
        if (!\is_string($url) || !\in_array($name, $this->served[self::urlKey($url)] ?? [], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $options = [];
        foreach (['only', 'exclude'] as $key) {
            if (isset($config[$key]) && \is_array($config[$key])) {
                $options[$key] = array_values(array_filter($config[$key], 'is_string'));
            }
        }
        if (\is_bool($config['canonical'] ?? null)) {
            $options['canonical'] = $config['canonical'];
        }
        $probe = new FilterRepository(new ArrayRepository([new CompletePackage($name, '1.0.0.0', '1.0.0')]), $options);

        return $probe->loadPackages([$name => null], self::STABLE, [])['namesFound'] !== [];
    }

    private static function base(BasePackage $package): BasePackage
    {
        return $package instanceof AliasPackage ? $package->getAliasOf() : $package;
    }

    private function admitsDev(string $name): bool
    {
        return StabilityFilter::isPackageAcceptable($this->acceptable, $this->stabilityFlags, [$name], 'dev');
    }
}

namespace Lockrot\Solver;

use Composer\Package\AliasPackage;
use Composer\Package\BasePackage;
use Composer\Package\CompletePackage;
use Composer\Package\Version\StabilityFilter;

/**
 * Loads a name's versions from the project's Composer, package and path repositories: the tagged stabilities first,
 * then `dev` for a name with no tagged release or one that the root admits at `dev`, as Composer's
 * repository loads a name's `~dev` file. Composer serves a file
